name: Nightmare/Reverse
source:
After ten years the protagonist visited his hometown for summer vacation. He'd dreamed that there was a murder here. 
He met with an old childhood friend and together went to the place he dreamed. They found a dead body... 
Then he dreamed again... another mysterious premonition...? Or worse?

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE094165.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
时隔十年，主人公回到故乡度暑假。他梦到了这里发生了一起谋杀案。他与一位老青梅竹马重逢，一起前往他梦中的地方。他们发现了一具尸体……然后他又做了一个梦……又一个神秘的预兆……？还是更糟的事？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE094165.html]DLsite English[/url]]
